title: Para Bellum content: the engine vocabulary
description: File: Content/vocabulary.json. Lists the engine-level names content files may use: stat keys, resource pools, facility kinds and settlement types. THE GAME NEVER READS THIS FILE TO DECIDE BEHAVIOUR. It describes the code; it does not extend it. A test in the game asserts that it equals the code exactly, so editing it cannot add a stat or a pool. Adding one is a code change, by design.

_comment.description: The header. It must carry the rule that the game never reads this file to decide behaviour. This key is the ONE EXPLICIT EXCEPTION to the content rule that unknown keys are refused (PB-C105): it is legal in this file only, and it is declared here rather than left implicit.

counter_symbols.description: The counter symbols the game's code can draw, which a template's symbol names.

facility_kinds.description: The engine facility kinds, in the code's declaration order, spelled exactly as facility.json's kind values.

settlement_types.description: The settlement types the map produces, none included.

policy_targets.description: What a policy level's effect may write, and how. A target of form share is one value from 0 to 1000 with exactly one writing policy; form modifier is a signed delta through the modifier stack's Policy layer, at least -1000, with any number of writers.

claim_roles.description: What the engine can do with a claim's share. civilian and construction have exactly one claim each; production has any number.
